changeManifest._note: ⛔⛔ VERSION 2 — THE RE-CUT (ODQ §934.47 addendum 9, ledger c22c25efc). VERSION 1'S DESIGN WAS REFUTED BY EXECUTION: it read generateRelationships(npcs, …) taking the roster as an argument and concluded the deriving half was pure. It is not — it DRAWS 67 times on the step's own stream (generateRelationships 62, generateFactions 2, generateConflicts 3), ambiently through npcGenerator.js:16's `import { random as _rng, pick as ctxPick } from '../kernel/rngContext.js'` bound by setActiveRng(stepRng) at pipeline.js:187, plus rng.random() at generatePopulation.js:123. THE RUNNER'S RE-CUT: runPipeline gains ONE option, `pins`, handed to every step THROUGH THE CONTEXT under the reserved key __pins, so step.fn(ctx, rng)'s signature is unchanged and no step is re-registered; __pins is stripped from the returned context and is exempt by name from the undeclared-write scan. ⛔ THERE IS NO SKIP — v1's whole-step `provides` skip is RETIRED, and not merely superseded: a step must advance its own stream for the steps that follow, and a skipped step cannot. Partial pinning THROWS (v1's rule 5 survives, re-aimed from provides to choosers). ⭐ IN THE SAME EDIT, the docblock's reference to `settlementSlice.applyChange` — which does not exist (git grep returns one unrelated comment at settlementRenameHelpers.js:37) — is corrected at +0 effective lines, since it is a comment. Measured 113 effective against the 800 ceiling, no size-baseline entry.

⛔⛔ ONE REGISTRATION, ONE STREAM, THE SEAM MOVED INSIDE. src/kernel/prng.js:84 is `fork: (label) => createPRNG(`${seed}::${label}`)` — a fork is createPRNG over a DERIVED SEED, a fresh stream at position 0, never a continuation — so two registered steps can NEVER share one stream position. Proved three ways over a 41-row sample of the 525-row corpus: V1 (two steps, each forking its own name) moved 41 of 41; V2 (two steps, the root half forking the string 'generatePopulation') ALSO moved 41 of 41, which convicts v1's §6 exactly — the root half gets that label's stream at position 0 and the derive half then gets its own at position 0 instead of continuing; V3 (ONE shared stream object) held 0 of 41. So the step keeps ONE registerStep and ONE stream object, and its body becomes drawPopulation + derivePopulation + a chooseOrPin helper IN THIS SAME FILE, the same rng object passed to both halves. ⛔ ALL SIX DECLARATIONS UNCHANGED: deps ['coherenceRepairPass','powerEconomyReconcilePass'], reads ['culture','economicState','effectiveConfig','generationContext','institutions','powerStructure','tier'], readsVersion { economicState: 'reconciled' }, provides ['npcs','relationships','factions','conflicts'], phase 'population', fn (ctx, rng). v1's worry that the derive half's `reads` would need `npcs` is MOOT — npcs never leaves the step body. All four choosers are wrapped, including the rng.random() scatter; chooseOrPin does NOT advance the stream when a pin is present, which is what makes a pinned re-derive reproduce the record. Measured 142 effective.

THE BATTERY — A1–A7. A1 is the packet's whole promise and the arm where version 1 FAILED AT 41 OF 41 SAMPLED ROWS: with no pins and with pins {}, output is byte-identical to the 525-row golden fixture and the prose manifest is unmoved. A3 counts draws in both modes — 67 in the derive half unpinned, ZERO fully pinned — and states that the two stream positions differ BY DESIGN. A5 REPLACES v1's fork-spelling conviction, which has no subject any more because the re-cut mints no fork: it asserts the step's rng handle is the SAME OBJECT IDENTITY (===) in both halves and that getStepOrder() holds exactly one 'generatePopulation' and no 'drawPopulation'. A7 scans the step file for exactly ONE registerStep( and ZERO fork( calls, with src/kernel/prng.js byte-identical to the base as its control — that derivation is owner-gated under THE PROMISE by its own header. Flat literal it(...) only (EM-PREAMBLE §P3.4). tests/generators IS an ENFORCER_DIR, so this file owes the row below.

The mutation-coverage row tests/generators/pipelinePinnedMode.test.js owes, because tests/generators is one of the eight ENFORCER_DIRS and enumerateInvariants picks every *.test.js under one. Added SURGICALLY beside its siblings; ⛔ the manifest is never re-serialised whole.

⛔⛔ THE FORK LAW, AND THE OTHER HALF OF THE REFUTATION. A fork is createPRNG over a derived seed — a FRESH stream at position 0, never a continuation — so two registered steps can never share a position. Its own header records that changing this derivation re-rolls every seeded stream in the product and is OWNER-GATED UNDER THE PROMISE.
